title: 비가 머물 자리 / A Place for Rain
story_moment: Before the returning passenger arrives. Empty prepared tray and hook; no umbrella, shoes, coat, soboro bread or bag already at home.
connection: A distant two-cup hint relates to the earlier Second Cup fiction. No game integration, real home, address, person or personal biography is depicted.

concept.role: Composition and atmosphere reference; not a projected image, background plate, dimensional survey or exact geometry reconstruction.

modeling.original_geometry: Lathed solid ceramic bowls, closed tray with raised ribs, beveled tiles, independently hinged door leaf/hardware, simple hook and console.
modeling.materials: Original procedural slate, plaster, wood and charcoal, with plain PBR brass, cup glaze and tea approximation; no external textures.

limits: No real home or construction survey
No functional door mechanism or drainage validation
No electrical, thermal, structural or manufacturing certification
Damp sheen is a material treatment, not a water simulation or evidence of the passenger's arrival
Tea is a visual secondary prop, not a food-contact or thermal model

render.kind: Actual independently modeled Blender Cycles render; not the generated concept image
render.reason: Installed Blender lacks OpenImageDenoise; fine grain remains, especially inside the doorway and on the floor
